evidence: Atomic submit freezes candidate, branch, base, exact evidence reference, acceptance-criteria hash, changed paths, selected and deferred checks, selection rationale, open findings, and a recomputable packet hash in one RNN submission packet.
Independent review accepts one hash-bound structured ledger whose findings are validated for severity order, unique IDs, criterion linkage, reproducibility, and required remediation.
Task review attempts, their submission packets, ledgers, findings, and closures are protected by an append-only history snapshot and prospective semantic validation.
Approval is denied while a blocking finding is open; later rounds must explicitly close prior findings, while the latest legacy review projection remains consistent with the immutable current round.

Remediation packets must name exactly the current open finding IDs, use a strict incremental evidence boundary, and preserve prior rounds; missing, extra, duplicate, and laundered finding surfaces fail closed.
A third submission after two adverse rounds is rejected unless it includes root-cause analysis and expanded incremental risk rationale.
taskctl submit --from prepares the evidence reference and immutable submission packet, transitions the task to REVIEW, and persists once under the already-loaded backlog compare-and-swap identity.

Stale-writer and replacement-failure tests prove neither evidence attachment nor REVIEW state is durably written on failure; existing tasks without review_control continue to validate without fabricated history.

The ECR and every slice page render immutable packets, completed review rounds, structured findings, explicit closures, current submission, and latest projection; legacy records are labeled as latest-review-only with no invented rounds.

The review-site manifest and checker exact-compare task packet, evidence, criteria, selection, ledger, finding, closure, and projection hashes against the authoritative backlog and reject flattening or omission.
